name: GPU-based Fluid Simulation with Voxel Rendering
aliases: Integrating Real-Time Fluid Simulation with a Voxel Engine
definition: A method for integrating real-time incompressible fluid simulation with sparse voxel-based rasterization on graphics hardware, specifically using Direct3D geometry shaders for rendering and compute shaders for simulation.
summary: GPU-based Fluid Simulation with Voxel Rendering integrates real-time incompressible fluid simulation with sparse voxel rasterization on graphics hardware, distinguishing itself by combining a fixed-grid Eulerian solver with a geometry-shader-driven voxel generation pipeline.
